shortDescription: A calmer place to plan your resume, track applications, and see how your job search is progressing.
description:
Keep the details of your job search together. Zebby gives every role a place for its job description, resume, notes, match analysis, and next step.

Plan before you apply
Bring in a job listing or paste its description. Compare it with your resume, review the reasons behind the match score, and work through core ATS keywords, resume themes, and suggested summary edits. Move a finished plan to Applied with its metadata and analysis intact.

Know where things stand
Track applications from Applied to Offer received. Search by role or company, filter by status, keep notes, and see the last 30 days of activity in a compact chart.

Choose how you analyze
Use a downloaded model, an Ollama server, your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key, or optional Zebby credits. Downloaded models use supported GPU acceleration or your CPU. Choose your model and supported thinking level in Settings.

Keep your files with you
Your applications and resumes live in a SQLite database you choose. Reuse resume versions, keep your notes close, and work in light or dark appearance.

Zebby is free to use for tracking and planning. Online analysis needs your own provider account or optional credit packs. Zebby credits are one-time purchases, with no subscription or Zebby signup. Local models download separately and run on your computer.
